title: CoPTS-KPFS results for the knapsack problem with forfeit sets
description: Best solutions found for the 600 instances of the benchmark of the knapsack problem with forfeit sets of D'Ambrosio et al. (2023) and the 60 KPFS-L instances, records of every run of the experiments of CoPTS-KPFS, a structure-guided cooperative tabu search with exact neighborhood evaluation on GPUs, reports of the analyses and a solution verifier. The data are distributed under CC BY 4.0 and the scripts under the MIT license.
